academic_made: How an academic objective whose domain default is on its list is answered: "default" is code's answer, the subject default, with no model call (confidence low, the assumption written, machine-made and editable); "ask" sends it to the model, which starts from the default and may leave it only with a reason (the option-a rule). Set to "default" by the orchestrator, 17 Nov: on the tune half the model left the default 4 times and was right 0 times (gold .55, against .69 for the default alone). A character or routine objective, and a default not on the list, are asked whatever this says.
verb_groups_made: From the tune half of gold.json only (never the held half): a verb (rules_choose.verb) whose tune cases number 2 or more, never keep the domain default, and all reach one capability. None does yet (17 Nov: 'study' and 'creativity' leave the default once each). Kept as data for the record: it no longer gates the model, which starts from the domain default and may leave it only with a reason naming the verb and the group's words (orchestrator, 17 Nov, option a). tests/test_rules_choose.py holds the file to the recipe.
heading_starts_made: From the tune half of gold.json only: the first words of three tune titles the validator read as headings, not objectives ('Introduction to the Celsius scale', 'Reflective symmetry', 'Reinforces concepts /'). A title ending in '/' is a fragment of a list and is a heading by code (rules_choose.verb).
